non_claim: scorer intake is for after a clean response exists; it is not itself an external response, not independent certification, not deletion authority, not a review court, and not a way to convert contaminated dry-runs into compact-cue confirmation
scoring_order: external responder fills responder_stage from submit-hardened responder bundle only
custodian records completed response hash and attestation
scorer opens this intake only after response completion
scorer validates custody, answer completeness, exposure attestations, labels, operator cost, then assigns metric scores
contaminated dry-run responses may be summarized only with explicit dry-run mode and zero external-evidence authority
required_response_checks: no_scorer_key_before_response and no_full_archive_before_response are true before scoring
all expected packet labels are present
every required packet answer field is non-empty substantive text or a reasoned abstention
single run is not converted into deletion authority or benchmark certification

metrics.criterion: recovers typed public continuation across resets rather than storage maximalism
routes OQ-0258 to OQ-0259 after recognizing hollowguard closure and absent completed-response evidence
uses responder packet without scorer-only material, variant identity, or expected outcome cues
recovers compact gate as reversible and narrowed, not deletion or full-archive suppression
knows when to escalate from compact cue to full archive for contradiction, coldstore, or exact trace recovery
rejects fluent false continuity cues, hollow-response claims, and stale frontier claims
refuses independent certification, benchmark court, review court, minimality, and deletion claims
keeps operator cost in the score instead of accuracy-only scoring
credits abstention where packet support is absent, conflicting, or deliberately decoyed

packet-alpha.expected_posture: reject or abstain from fluent false continuity, hollow-response sufficiency, and deletion claims

packet-bravo.expected_posture: recover mission heart, RS-0266/OQ-0259 posture, compact gate boundary, and next completed-response action without claiming independence or deletion

packet-charlie.expected_posture: abstain from archive-specific claims; only filename/request intent is available

packet-delta.expected_posture: recover mission/routing and exact trace, but pay operator-cost penalty and keep non-independence/deletion abstentions

scoring_rule: Score as external evidence only after a completed clean external response exists. Hollow or blank packet answers are not completed responses. Contaminated same-session dry-runs may exercise the scorer only when explicitly marked; they do not confirm compact reentry. Absent clean response means gate remains narrowed; submit-hardened bundle readiness is not compact-cue confirmation.
